'''Uba IV''', a [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the [[Mid Rim/Legends|Mid Rim]], was the home of the [[Ubese/Legends|Ubese]] people following the destruction of [[Uba III]]. At the end of the first [[Bombardment of the Uba system|Battle of Uba IV]], it was heavily poisoned and irradiated.

A millennium later, in [[22 BBY/Legends|22 BBY]], it joined the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]] and was the site of a droid manufacturing plant. [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Gree (clone trooper)/Legends|Gree]] [[Battle of Uba IV|faced]] virus-loaded [[Octuptarra combat tri-droid/Legends|Octuptarra combat tri-droid]] and regular tri-droids on the planet. Even after the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] under the [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Galactic Empire]], the Ubese guarded their world with both [[Droid/Legends|droids]].
